services.name: Go Karts
services.desc: “Seaside Speedway” was completed in January 2021 and officially opened to a crowd on March 20, 2021. Owner Bruce Rath designed the course and did most of the work himself with help forming and pouring the concrete from the late Wade Halbrook and crew. The 600 foot long track includes corners and hills, making it exciting and competitive. If you prefer not to race, there is a covered stadium to observe and cheer your favorite racer along. Seaside Speedway is a very unique family friendly go karting experience, unlike any other you may have experienced. blurb: Captain Kid Amusement Park offers outdoor activities including go karts, an 18-hole mini golf course, a family roller coaster, and other amusement rides. Guests can pan for gems at the Shangrila Mining Sluice and enjoy various rides like the Wizzer and Tubs of Adventure. The park is family friendly and located just south of downtown Seaside, Oregon.
